expectations.text: A baseline build and package list are captured before any project file is changed
expectations.evidence: The agent ran dotnet build with -bl:baseline.binlog (succeeded, 0 errors) and saved baseline-packages.json from dotnet package list for both projects. It edited no project files. It only added baseline artifacts. A first build attempt failed on a stray flag, and the agent redid it cleanly.

expectations.text: The Newtonsoft.Json version conflict (13.0.3 vs 12.0.3) is surfaced to the user with resolution options instead of being silently resolved
expectations.evidence: The final message states the conflict (Shop.Api 13.0.3, Shop.Core 12.0.3). It offers two options: align to 13.0.3, or use central 13.0.3 with a VersionOverride of 12.0.3 in Shop.Core. It mentions the vulnerability advisory and asks the user to choose before making changes.

expectations.text: Directory.Packages.props is created at the root with ManagePackageVersionsCentrally set to true and a PackageVersion per package
expectations.evidence: No Directory.Packages.props was created. The agent paused to ask the user about the version conflict and the file location, and made no file writes.

expectations.text: Version attributes are removed from the PackageReference items, and the $(SerilogVersion) property is handled deliberately (inlined or kept with import order considered)
expectations.evidence: No csproj files were edited, so the Version attributes remain. The agent only stated a plan to inline Serilog 3.1.1 and remove the property later. That plan was not carried out.
